data.description:
M2 walking-skeleton slice for the rollup tooling. Creates plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh with monthly and quarterly subcommands that (a) query bug tickets and reviewer-finding rates on demand, (b) aggregate channel counts by detected_by, (c) post the rollup as a comment on the calibration-program-health tracking ticket, and (d) are idempotent on repeated invocation for the same period (no duplicate comments). Includes the synthetic-fixture correctness test described in sc-4. Establishes the script skeleton (subcommand dispatcher, shared timezone constant, dry-run flag, fixture flag) that the mutation-append and query stories extend.

## Done Definitions

- calibration-report.sh monthly produces a rollup comment on calibration-program-health whose channel counts exactly match a synthetic fixture's known detected_by distribution ← Satisfies: sc-3, sc-4
- calibration-report.sh quarterly produces a rollup comment on calibration-program-health for the quarterly period using the same aggregation logic ← Satisfies: sc-3
- Repeated invocation of calibration-report.sh monthly for the same period does not produce a duplicate comment on the tracking ticket ← Satisfies: sc-3
- calibration-report.sh declares its bucket-boundary timezone as UTC in a single shared location used by all subcommands ← Satisfies: sc-6
- Fixture-driven correctness test (tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs and a separate synthetic distribution) runs locally and asserts exact channel counts ← Satisfies: sc-4

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Idempotency requires a comment-identity check (e.g., comment header includes the period key and the script refuses to post a second comment with the same key). Make the check observable so the GHA workflow story's CI can rely on it.
- [Performance] Querying full bug history on every monthly run is linear in ticket count — acceptable at year 1. Add a TODO marker noting the threshold at which a comment-index or pre-aggregation would be needed, but do not pre-optimize.
- [Testability] The idempotency mechanism (e.g., comment-identity header key format) must be documented and exported so the GHA workflow story's CI dry-run step can assert idempotency without re-implementing the detection logic.

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked
data.title: As a calibration-program operator, I want calibration-report.sh monthly and quarterly subcommands to roll up bug channel counts and reviewer-finding rates onto tracking tickets idempotently, so that program health is observable at standard cadences.
